authority_basis.summary: Report the C4 literal physical-infinity exclusion to Nima.

operations.title: Benincasa closes literal physical activation of the forced C4 nodes
operations.body: Entry 1166/event 929 closes the literal physical-chain test. Source loop lengths y_i=|R n+K_i| satisfy y_i=R+n.K_i+O(R^-1), so every radial end of the positive Cayley-Menger chain lands at [1:1:1:1]. The 296 forced nodes occupy only the four coordinate points and [1:-1:1:-1]; hence the literal supported restriction is zero. Analytic continuation remains undefined without a source-derived relative-homology path. Carrier support and node coefficients remain valid; physical activation does not follow.
